description: A plain settlement: the receipt opens at 100 and closes at 60, so the two numbers must be read on opposite sides of the transfer.
A full drain: closing is 0. Any implementation that reports the same balance twice fails here.
A zero-amount settlement, where a stale read happens to be right: opening and closing coincide, so this is the one case a misplaced read still passes. That is the v1 footgun's whole disguise.
One token unit off a million: the two reads differ by the smallest possible margin, so a receipt that reports one number twice is still wrong here.
The vault empties into an already-large recipient: closing is read from the vault, never from the recipient.
